name: Kou Gyokurei
source:
Star Sign: Aries
Elemental Attribute: Water
Special Attribute: Luck 1
Starting Spells: Fire 2/Lighting 2/Holy 2/Healing 3/Aging 2
Symbol: A cowry shell folding fan(Level 4)

Yume's roommate. A bright and energetic girl.
A heavenly maiden who is a studying abroad from the Kunlun Mountains.
Sometimes she says things that don't fit the situation and cause confusion to her surroundings.
